claim: A figure the game colours by writing ink over a rectangle of attribute cells can be drawn as sprites of the game's own pixels, so only those pixels take the colour and the rest of the cells stay black.

evidence.text: The car, which the game colours by OR-ing ink into a cell rectangle, became sprites of the game's own pixels, coloured from the ULA palette, mirrored by the X flag, clipped to that rectangle: no clash, the shadow black as in the original; 43 states, 111 frames exact, plus 103 more car frames.
evidence.quote: A figure the game colours by OR-ing ink into a cell rectangle (the car) became sprites of the game's own pixels
